# WaitUntilOptions

[API index](../index.md)

Configure sequential condition polling in WaitUntil.

**@keywords**

wait, timeout, polling, condition

## timeoutMs

```typescript
timeoutMs?: number;
```

Maximum elapsed milliseconds checked between condition calls; omitted means no timeout.
Zero performs one immediate check. Success on the deadline tick takes precedence.

**@keywords**

timeout, deadline, wait, condition

## pollIntervalMs

```typescript
pollIntervalMs?: number;
```

Milliseconds between completed false checks; omitted means 50, zero means next tick.

**@keywords**

polling, interval, wait, condition
